title: Generalized Functional ANOVA: A Complete Theoretical Framework
summary: The functional ANOVA provides a fundamental representation of square-integrable multivariate functions into main effects and higher-order interactions. For independent inputs, the components belong to mutually orthogonal Hilbert subspaces and admit an explicit representation. For dependent inputs, however, the components are only hierarchically orthogonal: although existence and uniqueness results are available, the Hilbert subspaces underlying the generalized decomposition have remained implicit.
